component.name: Nyanga
component.summary: A cute and cozy app that downloads manga

description.p: Nyanga downloads manga and saves it as one tidy file per volume, ready for whatever reader you like. Look a title up by name, pick the chapters with a tap, and the cat takes it from there.

ul.li: One CBZ, PDF or EPUB per volume, or per few chapters when a series has no volumes
Downloads a few files at a time, gently, and carries on where it stopped
A library of everything you have, with a badge when new chapters come out
Send the files to your phone over your home Wi-Fi with a QR code
Light and dark mode, and it keeps itself up to date

screenshot.caption: Looking a manga up and picking the volumes to download
